summary: Provident Financial Services filed a preliminary 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for an offering of fixed-to-floating rate subordinated notes due 2036, its own unsecured subordinated obligations. The notes pay a fixed rate semi-annually through the 2031 call date and Three-Month Term SOFR plus a spread thereafter, quarterly, in minimum $1,000 denominations. Rated as Tier 2 capital, the notes rank pari passu with existing subordinated debt, junior to senior debt, structurally subordinated to subsidiary liabilities, unlisted, and FDIC-uninsured. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. Watch final coupon, spread, size and Federal Reserve redemption approval requirements.
